company.name: Curebase
company.shortDescription: Curebase is the modern eClinical platform for faster study builds, better engagement, and seamless data capture.
company.description: Curebase is the modern eClinical platform built for flexibility, usability, and full-study oversight. We empower sponsors, CROs, and sites to launch studies faster, deliver better participant experiences, and seamlessly capture data with next-gen, AI-powered ePRO, eConsent, engagement tools, and integrated EDC.

productsAndServices.description: A platform to design, deploy, and collect patient-reported outcomes electronically via validated forms accessible on multiple devices.
productsAndServices.name: ePRO (Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes)

productsAndServices.description: A digital consent management system that delivers interactive, multimedia-informed consent experiences compliant with global regulations.
productsAndServices.name: eConsent

productsAndServices.description: An integrated electronic data capture system for clinical trial data entry, review, and management across devices and study sites.
productsAndServices.name: Electronic Data Capture (EDC)

productsAndServices.description: A set of integrated tools for managing patient communication, scheduling, reminders, payments, and engagement analytics within clinical trials.
productsAndServices.name: Patient Engagement Platform

productsAndServices.description: A module for running participant recruitment campaigns directly within the Curebase platform using multi-channel outreach and real-time tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Curebase Campaigns

productsAndServices.description: A collection of pre-built, compliance-ready electronic patient questionnaires and standardized data collection forms for clinical trials.
productsAndServices.name: Validated ePRO Forms Library

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $40,000,000, or 69.4% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,556,655 to $251,348,117, a 98.31x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 46 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 40 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Medidata, Veeva, Castor.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
